title: Autopsy 4.22：雜湊集合版本與路徑、內容的雙重分母
titleEn: Autopsy 4.22: hash-set versions and separate path/content denominators
subcategoryTitle: 鑑識時間線、證據來源與可重現分析
subcategoryTitleEn: Forensic timelines, provenance and reproducible analysis
summary: 建立路徑到內容雜湊的映射，固定雜湊集合版本及類別；同時報告路徑覆蓋與唯一內容覆蓋，保留未命中的檔案。
summaryEn: Build a path-to-content-hash mapping, pin the hash-set version and classification, and report both path coverage and unique-content coverage while retaining all unmatched files for further review.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

knowledge.textEn: Autopsy hash lookup compares files with configured sets, and changed sets may require ingest to run again. A match associates content with a set; it does not prove harmless context, use or execution behavior.

quiz.question: 「建立路徑到內容映射」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Map paths to content identities: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 路徑命中率65/100=65%，內容命中率50/80=62.5%；兩者分母不同，不能把其中一個稱為完整安全率。
交付path-content.csv、hashset-manifest.json、lookup-v1.json、lookup-v2.json與classification-limitations.md；不分享真實受調查檔案。
若更新集合但畫面命中未變，檢查是否重新執行查找；若用命中數排除調查，要求說明已知集合的分類與可信來源。
optionsEn: Path hit rate is 65/100=65%, while content hit rate is 50/80=62.5%. The denominators differ, and neither quantity is a comprehensive measure of security or benignness.

Deliver path-content.csv, hashset-manifest.json, lookup-v1.json, lookup-v2.json and classification-limitations.md. Use only synthetic file identities and do not redistribute real investigated files or sensitive evidence.

If the database changes but displayed hits do not, check whether lookup was rerun. If a hit is used to exclude investigation, request the set classification and the provenance supporting that interpretation.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。若更新集合但畫面命中未變，檢查是否重新執行查找；若用命中數排除調查，要求說明已知集合的分類與可信來源。 與本階段判準一起判讀：建立路徑到內容雜湊的映射，固定雜湊集合版本及類別；同時報告路徑覆蓋與唯一內容覆蓋，保留未命中的檔案。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. If the database changes but displayed hits do not, check whether lookup was rerun. If a hit is used to exclude investigation, request the set classification and the provenance supporting that interpretation. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Build a path-to-content-hash mapping, pin the hash-set version and classification, and report both path coverage and unique-content coverage while retaining all unmatched files for further review.

steps.title: 建立路徑到內容映射 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Map paths to content identities · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「建立路徑到內容映射」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Map paths to content identities and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若更新集合但畫面命中未變，檢查是否重新執行查找；若用命中數排除調查，要求說明已知集合的分類與可信來源。
對照「建立路徑到內容映射」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。讓內容相同的多路徑保持關聯而不刪除路徑脈絡；對新增匹配先記錄集合差異，再更新分析結論。
本階段必須重驗：建立路徑到內容雜湊的映射，固定雜湊集合版本及類別；同時報告路徑覆蓋與唯一內容覆蓋，保留未命中的檔案。
steps.instructionEn:
If the database changes but displayed hits do not, check whether lookup was rerun. If a hit is used to exclude investigation, request the set classification and the provenance supporting that interpretation.
Against the nominal Map paths to content identities result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Keep equal-content paths associated without deleting their contextual locations. For new matches, record the database delta first and update the analysis only after explaining what the new classification actually supports.
Reverify this criterion: Build a path-to-content-hash mapping, pin the hash-set version and classification, and report both path coverage and unique-content coverage while retaining all unmatched files for further review.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若更新集合但畫面命中未變，檢查是否重新執行查找；若用命中數排除調查，要求說明已知集合的分類與可信來源。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. If the database changes but displayed hits do not, check whether lookup was rerun. If a hit is used to exclude investigation, request the set classification and the provenance supporting that interpretation.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 建立路徑到內容雜湊的映射，固定雜湊集合版本及類別；同時報告路徑覆蓋與唯一內容覆蓋，保留未命中的檔案。
steps.checkEn: Build a path-to-content-hash mapping, pin the hash-set version and classification, and report both path coverage and unique-content coverage while retaining all unmatched files for further review.

stages.title: 建立路徑到內容映射
stages.description: 同一內容在多路徑出現，已知雜湊集合更新後命中也變動；本案要避免把known標籤視為安全證明，或把路徑命中數當成不同檔案內容數。 建立路徑到內容雜湊的映射，固定雜湊集合版本及類別；同時報告路徑覆蓋與唯一內容覆蓋，保留未命中的檔案。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 本課Autopsy 4.22雜湊查找文件中的lookup主要使用MD5；SHA-256可另作證據內容完整性欄位，不能宣稱該版本hashset查找會使用它。教學資料使用獨特內容代號，不生成碰撞或分發真實樣本。
stages.descriptionEn: Identical content appears at several paths, and hash-set updates change lookup results. The case prevents treating a known label as proof of safety or confusing path hits with distinct content identities. Build a path-to-content-hash mapping, pin the hash-set version and classification, and report both path coverage and unique-content coverage while retaining all unmatched files for further review. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. In the cited Autopsy 4.22 documentation, hash-set lookup uses MD5; SHA-256 can be retained separately for evidence-content integrity. Do not claim that this version uses SHA-256 for the documented hash-set lookup. The fixture uses distinct content identifiers without generating collisions or distributing real investigated samples.
